summary:
Research of w195 (supervision r122, whole-suite expected red for capability-proposals) is done; notes.md holds the seven parts.
Red today: 9 of 10 rows of features/supervision.feature:813 fail: 6 undefined Givens (line 817), 3 undefined Then (line 820). One row passes only by coincidence.
Code: scripts/work_items.py acceptors (58) and expect_red (79) read work-items only; no proposal branch. Probe: every proposal case counted as not expected today.
Steps: tests/scenarios/supervision_proposal_steps.py needs a generic Given for approved, withdrawn, awaiting-answer, merged; tests/scenarios/supervision_tests_steps.py needs the implement-stage Then.
No existing test becomes impossible to keep (by search; no tools map). Implement and merge suite runs share one command, so one change in work_items.py covers both.
Old assumption: model_work SETTLED counts merged as settled; r122 counts it expected. work run never writes merged. Probe D2: --whole-suite with an unknown work-item runs instead of refusing.
Size: no tracked Python file over 300 lines.
questions: merged: counted as expected by r122 (the outline row), or settled as model_work.py treats it, which work run never writes?
Should --whole-suite with an unknown work-item refuse as the scenario path does (probe_skip.py), or run?
